motion_adaptations: Original ProjectMenu vertex/fragment shaders (1200-unit bend, 12-unit ripple), four fluid passes, screen spectrum/grain/vignette and HomeContact transition shader. Adapted to Three.js r180: renamed luminance to avoid a built-in name collision; guarded zero-length vectors; explicit color output conversion. DOM pixel-to-world scaling and local portfolio route/canvas integration are new. Native links, accessible content and clear-image fallback are retained.
clarity_adaptation: Spectral blur, grain and vignette are restricted to the background pass. Full-resolution portfolio textures render directly to the antialiased display framebuffer at up to 2x DPR, with original geometric bend and fluid displacement. Additive image whitening is removed; image fog begins beyond the foreground plane. Offscreen viewport sizing no longer applies display DPR twice.
note: Reference assets and motion code retained for the user's explicit request to use the original effect. Portfolio content is separate. No tracking scripts are loaded.
